request.style: English, heartfelt country, male and female duet in close harmony, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, piano, brushed drums, warm storytelling, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The famine came to Canaan and the fields were cracked and bare
Old Jacob sent his sons to Egypt, there was grain for buying there
They bowed before the governor, they did not know his face
The brother that they sold away was standing in that place

[Verse]
He could not hold it any longer, so he cleared the room
And wept so loud that all of Pharaoh's household heard it too
I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt
Come closer to me

[Chorus]
You intended evil against me
But God intended it for good
To accomplish what is now being done
The saving of many lives
So do not be afraid
I will provide for you and your children

[Bridge]
Do not be distressed, and do not be angry with yourselves that you sold me here
God sent me ahead of you to preserve life
It was not you who sent me here, but God

[Verse]
The years went by and Jacob died, the brothers shook with fear
What if he holds a grudge against us, now our father is not here
They fell down at his feet and said, we are your slaves today
But Joseph wept and spoke to them, and kindly he would say

[Chorus]
You intended evil against me
But God intended it for good
To accomplish what is now being done
The saving of many lives
So do not be afraid
I will provide for you and your children

[Outro]
But God intended it for good
The saving of many lives
